# jumpcloud_software_app (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud software application by ID or display name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by display name
data "jumpcloud_software_app" "chrome" {
  display_name = "Google Chrome"
}

# Look up by ID
data "jumpcloud_software_app" "by_id" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the software application. Exactly one of id or display_name must be specified.
- `id` (String) The ID of the software application. Exactly one of id or display_name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `settings` (String) JSON-encoded settings for the software application.
